title: Morphism-theoretic conventions from file 02
statement:
All morphism-theoretic notions for morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] used below are the ones fixed in
Definition [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] ("file 02" of the source): *quasi-compact*, *quasi-separated*,
*separated*, *locally of finite type* and *of finite
type* ([def-weil-finite-type-morphism]), *locally of finite presentation* and *of finite
presentation* ([def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]; of finite presentation meaning locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated), *surjective*, *open immersion*,
*closed immersion*, *immersion*, *universally closed*,
*proper*, *finite*, *integral*, *flat*,
*unramified*, *étale*, *geometric fibre* and
*geometric point*, each as defined in the node that
Definition [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] names for it.
One further notion is fixed here: *projective*
([def-pc-projective-morphism]).
